description_en: Queries the performance metrics and sampling data of a specified PolarFS instance within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询指定 PolarFS 实例在指定时间范围内的性能指标和采样数据
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-polar-fs-performance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --polar-fs-instance-id 'pfs-2ze0i74ka607*****' --key Capacity --start-time 2024-10-07T02:04:00Z --end-time 2024-10-07T03:04:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePolarFsPerformance

parameters.help_en: The monitoring metric group. Valid values: Capacity (capacity), Inode (file nodes), Iops (read and write operations per second), Latency (read and write latency), QpsMeta (metadata operation requests), and Throughput (read and write throughput)
parameters.help_zh: 监控指标组。支持 Capacity（容量）、Inode（文件节点）、Iops（每秒读写操作数）、Latency（读写延迟）、QpsMeta（元数据操作请求数）和 Throughput（读写吞吐量）
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must not be earlier than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ，使用 UTC 时间，不得早于开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sampling granularity of performance data, in seconds. The value must be a multiple of 60 and greater than 0. Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh: 性能数据采样粒度，单位为秒。必须为大于 0 的 60 的整数倍，默认值为 60
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time is in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time is in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间，使用 UTC 时间
